groups.what: Route the work: they take Dinis's word, write the briefs and start the agents he asks for.
One agent per place, each running its own research and publish loop and signing its place's file with the site's key.
Started on 15 November: the agents made visible, the data queryable, the detectives connecting the dots, the iOS app.
The build, the gate, the features and the look of every page.
Policies, reviews, budgets, the health of CI and the backups.
Writers, researchers, the graph, the readers' guides and the record.

layers.t: Dinis gives the direction, in his own words, kept as he gave them: {guidance} pieces of guidance and {briefs} briefs.
The conductors turn each word into briefs and start the agents it needs, at Dinis's word only.
{agents} agents, each a Claude session with its own key, its own policy and its own files. {active} committed in the last 24 hours.
{commits} commits by agents in the last 24 hours, {status} status files, {runs} run reports. Nothing happens off the record.

The gate builds the whole site and refuses a release that breaks a rule: schemas, sources and read dates, links, signatures, banned hosts. CI then numbers the release and deploys it. {releases} releases so far, the latest {version}.
{pages} pages, {places} place sites and their newsrooms, every page with a markdown twin for agents and readers alike.

cells: **Agents in your environment.** One agent per role, each with a brief that keeps your words.
{agents} agents, one per role or place, in this repository and its cloud sessions; Dinis's words kept in board/guidance/ ({guidance} pieces).
**A key per agent.** Each agent makes its own key pair; only the public half is published.
{active_keys} live keys in board/keys.json, each committed by its own agent.
**A board of files.** One markdown file per piece of work, in git.
{board} files in board/: briefs, passes, decisions, status, debriefs, run reports.
**A console.** A page where you see your agents, their board and their activity.
[The newsroom](../newsroom/index.md), the agents panel on every place page and each place's newsroom.
**A stop file.** Create one file and every agent stops at its next wake.
board/HOLD.md (security@ may write it, only Dinis lifts it): {hold}.
**Gated releases.** Nothing ships unless a validator passes.
The gate runs before every push and again in CI: {releases} releases.
**Open.** Code under open licences, everything else under Creative Commons.
This repository and its record are public.
**Atomic cells.** Each useful on its own, removable without breaking the rest.
Each place agent owns one file and one page; the build keeps going if one file breaks.
